title: #82 Invented Things
prompt: What are the advantages and disadvantages of living in an era in which new things are constantly being invented?

promptSegments.text: What are the advantages and disadvantages of living in an era in which new things are constantly being invented?

hardVocabulary.enGloss: A key word in this prompt.
A key word in this prompt.

requirements.en: Discuss the important advantages and disadvantages.
requirements.vi: Thảo luận những ưu điểm và nhược điểm quan trọng.
Đưa ra nhận định tổng thể theo yêu cầu.

requirements.en: Support the comparison with relevant examples.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ phần so sánh bằng ví dụ phù hợp.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: New inventions simplify daily tasks, saving people time and effort.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: New inventions simplify daily tasks, saving people time and effort.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: New things help solve problems, such as medical tools allowing early detection of sicknesses.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: New things help solve problems, such as medical tools allowing early detection of sicknesses.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: New inventions make life too fast and cause people to lose simple human connections.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: New inventions make life too fast and cause people to lose simple human connections.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The cost of new things creates a big gap between rich and poor people.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The cost of new things creates a big gap between rich and poor people.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The primary advantage of constant invention is its ability to solve previously difficult problems, such as medical treatments that allow people to live longer and healthier lives.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The primary advantage of constant invention is its ability to solve previously difficult problems, such as medical treatments that allow people to live longer and healthier lives.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Another benefit is that technology simplifies tasks by taking over hard and repetitive jobs, exemplified by online banking which saves time and eliminates the need to travel to a bank.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Another benefit is that technology simplifies tasks by taking over hard and repetitive jobs, exemplified by online banking which saves time and eliminates the need to travel to a bank.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The constant pressure to keep up with new technology causes mental stress.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The constant pressure to keep up with new technology causes mental stress.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Over-reliance on machines leads to the loss of basic human skills.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Over-reliance on machines leads to the loss of basic human skills.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not list advantages and disadvantages without making the required judgement.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ liệt kê ưu nhược điểm mà quên đưa ra nhận định bắt buộc.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?

faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?

faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.
